## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new functionality
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `chore` / `ci` — tooling, deps, pipeline
- [ ] `refactor` / `perf` — no behaviour change

## Checklist

- [ ] Branch follows the naming convention (`feature/…`, `fix/…`, `chore/…`, `docs/…`)
- [ ] `uv run ruff check .` passes
- [ ] `uv run ruff format --check .` passes
- [ ] `uv run mypy` passes (strict)
- [ ] `uv run pytest` passes; coverage not reduced
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or real personal data committed
- [ ] Tests added/updated for the change

## Safety review (human-in-the-loop invariants)

- [ ] Does **not** introduce unattended bulk auto-apply
- [ ] Does **not** enable fabrication of resume content
- [ ] Does **not** scrape prohibited sources (LinkedIn/Indeed)
